sentences.en: The manmade dam provides water for the nearby city.
sentences.zh: 这个人工坝为附近的城市提供水源。

sentences.en: Visitors can walk on top of the manmade dam to enjoy the view.
sentences.zh: 游客可以走在人工坝上欣赏风景。

sentences.en: The construction of a new manmade dam will help regulate the river flow.
sentences.zh: 修建新的人工坝将有助于调节河流流量。
